entities.summary: Shen Yue, courtesy name Xiuwen (休文), was a Chinese historian, music theorist, poet, and politician born in Huzhou, Zhejiang. He served emperors under the Liu Song dynasty, the Southern Qi dynasty, and the Liang dynasty of Southern Dynasties era.
